title: Eisenhower shown five spacecraft at Edwards
place_text: Edwards Air Force Base, California (also said Alamogordo)

No cameras, no press and uh sitting on the runway at Edwards were five spacecraft with extraterrestrial spyome and that he they were shown to Ike Eisenhower.

tellings.difference: Says the cover story was a dentist appointment rather than golf, gives the year as 1954, and calls it a meeting without mentioning five spacecraft.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Eisenhower's 1954 absence from Palm Springs, when he was allegedly taken to Edwards AFB to meet aliens or see their craft.

as_told.title: Eisenhower's 1954 alleged alien meeting at Edwards AFB
as_told.place_text: Palm Springs / Edwards Air Force Base, California

plain: The story goes that in the 1950s President Dwight D. Eisenhower vanished from public view for a day and was secretly taken to Edwards Air Force Base in California, where he was shown craft from another world. It is told by Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force site in Nevada. Hall is repeating what others have told him, and he points to the television series Ancient Aliens. In his version, the official story was that Eisenhower was golfing in Palm Springs, and with no cameras and no press present he was shown five spacecraft sitting on the runway at Edwards. Michels tells it on his own in a later episode with an Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman. He puts it in 1954, says the cover story was a dentist appointment rather than golf, and calls it a meeting without mentioning the five craft. If true, it would mean an American president was personally briefed on alien visitors seventy years ago.
